summary: Exclude demonstration and foreign trees from automatic project detection

delivery.outcome: Detect only owned root and bounded package projects; prune demonstrations, fixtures, generated, vendor and foreign checkout trees before selecting test commands. Publish the two-file fix through independent protected merge.
nonGoals: Change explicit project configuration or bootstrap commands
Change version, dependencies, delivery approval or production files outside the two owned paths

architecture.decision: Prune a bounded depth-three os.walk before descent, do not follow symbolic links, and stop at any nested .git marker; retain owned packages and root manifests. Reuse existing project-type patterns without adding language dictionaries.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected publication retaining independent receipts.

validation.evidence: Demonstrations and foreign trees cannot select languages; owned adapters remain detectable.
Full Python tests and native Goal publication succeed, with exact-head OneDev and independent protected merge.
